//: Committed defaults ONLY. Never put real credentials in this file — it is tracked by git. Real values belong in the git-ignored appsettings.Local.json, which scripts/setup.sh|ps1 generates from the repo-root .env.

Logging.//: A comment inside LogLevel would be parsed as a category with an invalid level. EF Core's SQL logging is off here: every statement at Information filled logs/api.log to 2 GB in two days on the live desk. Development turns it back on.

LotSizes.//: Fallback lot size per underlying, used when the broker master does not carry one. The MCX master never does - every commodity row reports 1 - so these are the only source for MCX and MUST match the exchange's contract specs. Verify before trading an instrument that is not already in use.

Frontend._comment: BaseUrl is an optional override for where the broker callback sends the browser afterwards. Unset, it returns to the origin the callback arrived on — the domain through the tunnel, localhost in development — which is always a page the API itself serves. Set it (e.g. in appsettings.Local.json) only to land on a separate dev server such as http://localhost:5173.
